Run complete. The prototype reached the gate's stop line at 20 minutes; the served page is a hair over at 360.

**Milestones (minutes from t0 = 07:56:37Z)**

| event | +min | 360 / 1440 / 2560 % |
|---|---|---|
| `first` done | 1.4 | 28.3 / 38.3 / 29.1 |
| r1 (document rewrite + all CSS) | 5.7 | 20.3 / 11.4 / 8.95 |
| r2 | 7.2 | 14.3 / 11.4 / 8.95 |

| served gate | 22.3 | 10.05 / 7.69 / 5.09 |

Setup took about 9 minutes, not counted. Tool seconds t0 to stop from TIMING.log: 405 s (first 86, two harness runs 14, nine rounds 305). Leak prototype vs served at 1440: identical across 12 wrappers. The served 360 figure sits 0.05 above the line and no polish round was run, per the protocol.

**Five largest non-tool chunks**
- Reading cards, drafts, document and the 1440 side-by-side, deciding to rewrite the document: ~3 min.
- Writing the document plus four block CSS files and styles.css in one pass: ~2.5 min.
- Reading header/footer DOM and writing their CSS: ~2.5 min.
- Section views and crop reading at 360 and 1440 across rounds 4 to 6: ~4 min.
- The write-up after the clock: ~5 min.

**Three costliest tool defects**
- `author` emitted the card sections as stacked default content with links-only blocks, dropped the accordion links and tabs, and left the icons as dead placeholders. That forced a full document rewrite by hand and set the first round at 28 / 38 / 29.
- The chrome drafts: `header.css` draws one 160 px bar where the live page has three, and `footer.css` fixes the height and stacks four groups in one column. The digest has no header or footer row, so those bands were only found in the side-by-side.
- The Δh sign is not stated. The page row at 1440 read −2421 while the build was taller, and `section-view` reads build minus live. I moved the 360 footer the wrong way once, which cost round 5.

**Residuals registered**: the live page's blank lazy-loaded teaser image (about 10 % of the About section at 360, not copied on purpose), the region select control, the nav document missing the header's main row and search, and two small unexplained 360 offsets.

Paths: `migration/cases/home/NOTES.md`, `migration/cases/home/TIMELINE.md`, plus REPORT.md, REGISTER.md and TIMING.log alongside, all committed and pushed on `blocks-first` of `aemcoder-adobe/sdt-rbc-b09r`. Preview: https://blocks-first--sdt-rbc-b09r--aemcoder-adobe.aem.page/drafts/rbc-home
